children: Overview
China lozenge maker's H1 revenue fell yr/yr
Gross profit dropped and profit attributable to equity holders fell
Company did not declare an interim dividend for the reporting period
Outlook
Golden Throat plans to expand online channels in 2026, exploring live-stream e-commerce, private-domain communities and new retail
Result Drivers
HIGHER ADVERTISING – Selling and distribution expenses rose 12.1%, primarily due to increased advertising expenditure
CAUTIOUS CONSUMER SPENDING - Co cited increasingly cautious consumer spending as a factor in weaker results
INTENSIFIED COMPETITION - Co said intensified market competition contributed to the challenging environment
